tagline: Continue your Solstice journey with three days of practice, rest and integration.

highlights: A place to exhale after the intensity of Solstice.

about.title: A quieter landing after Solstice
about.body: This is designed as a natural continuation after Summer Solstice: an in-person women's experience to reset your nervous system, reconnect with intuition and carry the teachings into daily life.

callout.title: Meals included. Lodging is not included.
callout.body: The venue is about a 20-minute drive from Ram Das Puri, with nearby access to everyday essentials in Espanola.

banner.title: Member savings
banner.body: 3HO Premium members and active IKYTA members can receive an additional $50 off with a member-only code at checkout.

items.question: Is lodging included?
items.answer: No. On-site lodging is not included with registration. 3HO lists two nearby options for people who want to stay close to Hacienda Guru Ram Das Ashram.

items.question: Can I attend if I am new to Kundalini Yoga?
items.answer: Yes. The experience is beginner-friendly. Teachers will offer guidance and options so participants can practice at their own pace, rest, modify, or step out as needed.

items.question: What language will the event use?
items.answer: The experience is primarily in English. Spanish support or translation will be available as needed for English- and Spanish-speaking participants.

items.question: How does the transition work after Summer Solstice?
items.answer: After Summer Solstice, participants travel from Ram Das Puri to Hacienda Guru Ram Das Ashram in Espanola for the June 29 start. Organizers will share check-in details, start time, and what to bring.

items.question: What is the refund or transfer policy?
items.answer:
Cancellation requests made up to 15 days before the event may receive a partial refund. A $75 cancellation fee applies, and transaction or booking fees are not refunded.

From 15 days before the event through the first day, refunds are not available. Payment may be transferred to another attendee for the same event by written request.

items.question: Is there a member discount?
items.answer: Yes. 3HO Premium members and active IKYTA members can receive an additional $50 off by requesting a member-only code and applying it at checkout.
